companies.name: F&Gアニュイティーズ&ライフ

relations.text: 約70%を保有する子会社(2025年末に約12%を株主へ分配)
relations.text_en: Majority-owned (about 70%) after a further 12% distribution at end-2025

source.label: FNF 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As a result of the 2025 F&G Distribution, we own approximately 70% of the common stock of F&G.

relations.text: 分離・コーポレートサービス契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Bound by separation and corporate services agreements

source.label: F&G Annuities & Life 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Separation and Distribution Agreement, dated as of November 30, 2022, between Fidelity National Financial, Inc. and F&G Annuities & Life, Inc.

relations.text: PaysafeがFNFとCannaeから自社株約400万株を買い戻した(2025年11月)
relations.text_en: Paysafe bought back about 4 million shares from FNF and Cannae (November 2025)

source.label: Paysafe 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 24, 2025, we entered into privately negotiated agreements with Cannae and Fidelity National Financial, Inc. to repurchase approximately 4 million of our common shares.

companies.name: ジェナ・アクイジションII

relations.text: 過去の案件でFNFが資金の全額引受けに参加したと記載
relations.text_en: Cites a past deal in which FNF helped fully backstop the funding

source.label: Jena Acquisition II S-1/A
source.quote: Funds advised by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities, funds advised by GSO Capital Partners LP and Fidelity National Financial (NYSE: FNF) provided a full backstop to ensure certainty of funding.

companies.name: カナエ・ホールディングス

relations.text: FNFがCannaeに最大1億ドルの融資枠を提供(2017年から)
relations.text_en: FNF has lent to Cannae under a revolver of up to $100 million since 2017

source.label: Cannae Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: FNF Revolver On November 17, 2017, Fidelity National Financial ("FNF") issued to Cannae a revolver note in aggregate principal amount of up to $ 100.0 million.

source.quote: Our major nationwide competitors in our principal markets include Fidelity National Financial, Inc.
